decisions.statement: A dependent is found by reading the sources rather than by running those sources.
The markup files are read for dependents as well as the sources.
A global a call names is reported whether or not that global has dependents.
Naming no global reports only the globals a menu entry is bound to.
A global an addon saves its variables under is one that addon writes.
A JSON answer here is one report a line rather than one document.

definition: the command naming what depends on an addon global and ruling whether renaming it is safe
